# Code Generation Guidance

Generate Python code wrapped in custom delimiters (NOT markdown code blocks):
===RAVL_CODE_START===
[Your Python code here]
===RAVL_CODE_END===

Your generated code should:

- Save results to file in: paths/ (use relative path from project root, or use absolute paths for desktop/explicit locations)
- File format: JSON
- Each item should have fields: name, id

# Subprocess/Child Loop Execution:
- OPTIONAL HELPER: from ravl.common.execution.subprocess_helpers import SubprocessHelper
- Use SubprocessHelper.get_project_root() to find ravl script location
- Use SubprocessHelper.call_with_clean_env() to run commands without venv interference
- Or implement environment cleanup inline (remove VIRTUAL_ENV, clean PATH)
- Example: SubprocessHelper.call_with_clean_env([f'{project_root}/ravl', 'child_loop'], cwd=project_root)

# Your code will be verified against:
- - All available example loops are listed with their names/paths
- - Each example includes a brief, clear explanation of its purpose
- - Examples with child loops are identified and noted as part of the same example family
- - Output is displayed to screen in a readable format
- - No files are created or modified
- - No errors occur during directory scanning or loop discovery
